field.label: Subscriber Key
field.help: Enter the Ki Key associated with the IMSI.

field.label: OPc
field.help: Enter 32 hexadecimal digits for OPc, or leave it blank when using OP.

field.label: OP
field.help: Enter 32 hexadecimal digits for OP, or leave it blank when using OPc.

field.label: Authentication Management Field
field.help: Enter four hexadecimal digits. New subscribers default to 8000.

field.label: MSISDN
field.help: Enter up to two phone numbers using digits only, separated by a comma.

field.label: IP
field.help: Optionally enter a persistent IP from the UE pool.

field.label: UE-AMBR Downlink
field.help: Subscriber-wide downlink limit. Enter a whole number and its unit.

field.label: UE-AMBR Uplink
field.help: Subscriber-wide uplink limit. Enter a whole number and its unit.

field.label: Operator-Determined Barring
field.help: Enter the Open5GS barring code from 0 to 8.

field.label: Profile
field.help: Define the profile (APN) to be associated with the IMSI.

field.label: Default Slice
field.help: Enter an assigned SST or SST:SD, for example 1 or 1:010203. Leave blank to keep the current default on edit or use the first assigned slice for a new subscriber.

field.label: Per-Session Address Overrides
field.help: Optional JSON keyed by SST[:SD]/APN. Use ue or smf with ipv4 or ipv6 fields. For example, {"1/internet":{"ue":{"ipv4":"192.0.2.10"}}}. Omit an address to leave it unchanged, or use null to clear it. These overrides take precedence over the single IP field.

field.label: Per-Session PCC Rules
field.help: Optional JSON keyed by SST[:SD]/APN. Each value is an array of Open5GS PCC rules with flow and qos. Omit a session to keep its rules, or use [] to clear them.
